thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: Router tail latency SLO breach in multiple zones (p99 elevated) — auto-escalation to oncall. Links: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/routers/latency?orgId=1
oncall-alex: I’m on it. Observed p95 jump ~3m ago. Which customers are hitting this the worst?
sre-jess: seeing sustained p99 jump in eu-west-1 and us-east-1. Streaming stalls reported on some sessions. Dashboards show router egress queue depth rising.
eng-runtime-ram: we pushed a routing-weight rollout earlier (weight-based fallback policy) — could be correlated. I’ll check rollout history and the config change ID: `cfg-2026-03-12-rtw`.
ops-maya: hotkey heatmap shows a small set of shards getting 8x traffic. Might be a hot partition on the LB side, causing backend overloads.
support-lin: two enterprise customers (#acme-corp, #zenhealth) opened support tickets: "streaming cutouts, tokens stuck buffering". They're on dedicated pools in eu-west-1.
oncall-alex: ok prioritize: 1) identify whether rollout changed routing preferences 2) mitigate hot partition (temporary deweight) 3) confirm customer impact and whether to apply capacity burst.
incident-bot: Related alerts: router.p99_latency > 800ms (count 76), router.queue_depth > 300 (count 1m), routing.errors.fallback_rate spike. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/infrastructure/runbooks/router-tail
sre-jess: running quick queries now.

sre-jess: logs show a steady increase in `route.hit_rate` for a specific shard id `shard-42-eu`. Entries:
```
2026-03-12T12:03:14Z route=shard-42-eu hit=1242 p99=1200ms downstream_errors=5
2026-03-12T12:04:02Z route=shard-42-eu hit=1368 p99=1400ms downstream_errors=12
```
Looks like KV-cache locality is skewed; shard-42 is overloaded.
eng-runtime-ram: that matches the rollout: weights for shard-42 increased for latency optimization in cfg-2026-03-12-rtw. Might be a bad seed in the weight compute.
ops-maya: I can deweight shard-42 at the LB layer for a quick mitigation. Suggest deweight to 0.2 of normal for 10m then monitor.
oncall-alex: go ahead and deweight. Also add fallback to older routing policy across regions if deweight doesn't bring p99 down in 5m.

ops-maya: executing command now:
```
# deweight shard-42 in eu-west-1
lbctl set-weight --shard shard-42-eu --zone eu-west-1 --weight 0.2 --reason "hot partition mitigation"
```
ops-maya: :white_check_mark: command issued. Observability will update in ~30s.
sre-jess: adding temporary alert suppression on noise and creating a ticket for rollback plan.

support-lin: notifying affected customers with the short blurb: "We’re investigating increased latency and streaming stalls. Mitigation is in progress; we’ll update in 15 minutes." Sending now.
pm-oliver: thanks — please capture affected request IDs for postmortem; prioritize enterprise impact metrics (errors/sec, dropped streams).

incident-bot: Update: mitigation action logged by ops-maya (deweight). Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/routers/latency?view=live
sre-jess: p99 trending down in eu-west-1 from ~1.4s -> 420ms in last 90s. Queue depth decreasing.
oncall-alex: good. Keep monitoring for 10m. eng-runtime-ram, can you audit the rollout algorithm and revert if config is root cause?
eng-runtime-ram: will check diffs and open a rollback CL if needed. Quick grep shows `weight_compute(seed=42)` was used; we may have collision with recent shard mapping changes.

support-lin: customers updated: both acknowledged and will monitor. No legal/contract breach reported yet.
pm-oliver: create a short incident ticket with customer impact summary and owners for follow-up: SRE to stabilize, Runtime to audit rollout, Ops to review LB heuristics.

sre-jess: created INC-2026-8892 with initial notes + timeline.
oncall-alex: starting handoff to day team. @sre-jess you keep incident lead until that handoff completes. I’m logging off call but will be reachable if things regress.

sre-jess: notes for handoff: cause suspected: routing-weight rollout increased load to shard-42 -> hot partition -> downstream queues -> streaming stalls -> p99 spike. Mitigation: deweight shard-42, monitoring shows improvement. Follow-ups: revert/modify rollout logic, add canary checks for hotkey amplification, add automatic self-healing deweight when per-shard hit_rate > threshold.
eng-runtime-ram: assigned owner for rollout audit: ram; will open PR for safer tuning and add a canary flag.
ops-maya: will create a playbook snippet to automate temporary deweight with validation checks.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Next update due in 30m or on regression.
sre-jess: closing thread on Slack, full postmortem to be filed in INC-2026-8892. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
